profile.headline: Software Engineer III at UKG
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing and building scalable SaaS platforms, fintech products, and cloud-native applications.

I specialize in full-stack development, distributed systems, cloud architecture, and platform engineering, with extensive experience leading the design and implementation of high-performance solutions used by thousands of users worldwide.

Throughout my career, I have worked on complex multi-tenant platforms, real-time systems, trading technologies, AI-powered applications, and enterprise software, focusing on scalability, reliability, observability, and exceptional user experience.

My expertise includes system architecture, backend services, frontend applications, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automation, and AI/LLM integrations.

Core Technologies:
• .NET Core / ASP.NET Core
• C# / Entity Framework
• React, Next.js, TypeScript
• SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis
• Azure, AWS, DigitalOcean
• Docker, Terraform
• SignalR, REST APIs, Microservices
• CI/CD, DevOps & Cloud Automation
• AI & LLM Integrations
• Distributed Systems & SaaS Architecture

Passionate about building products that solve real business problems while maintaining engineering excellence, performance, and long-term scalability.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Boca Raton, Florida, United States · On-site
positions.description:
FPFX Technologies develops enterprise SaaS platforms for the trading industry, serving proprietary trading firms, brokerages, and asset managers worldwide.

Key Contributions

* Designed and delivered scalable cloud-native features across multiple enterprise SaaS products, including BullRush, PropAccount, and internal operational platforms.
* Led the architecture and implementation of high-impact backend services using ASP.NET Core, .NET 8, Entity Framework Core, MediatR, SignalR, RabbitMQ, SQL Server, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and Azure.
* Built resilient distributed systems supporting competition management, account provisioning, payments, affiliate programs, leaderboards, real-time trading experiences, and operational automation.
* Improved platform reliability by troubleshooting and optimizing high-throughput production environments, including database performance, distributed caching, background processing, and cloud infrastructure.
* Designed and implemented secure REST APIs, event-driven workflows, authentication/authorization, and scalable integration patterns across multiple services.
* Collaborated closely with Product, QA, DevOps, Operations, and Customer Success teams to translate complex business requirements into production-ready solutions.
* Participated in architectural decisions focused on scalability, maintainability, observability, and long-term platform evolution.
* Contributed to Azure DevOps and GitLab workflows, including source control, merge requests, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release management.
* Mentored developers through code reviews, architectural discussions, and engineering best practices.
